prompt:
I want a fully tailored, ATS-optimized resume for this senior cybersecurity analyst role I'm applying for. Please generate a professional Markdown resume that meets ALL the following requirements exactly:

- Analyze the entire job description below to extract key skills, qualifications, and keywords. Indicate what the company values most.
- Use my current resume content as the basis and map my experience to the job requirements, highlighting transferable skills clearly.
- Create a concise professional summary (3-4 lines) that includes years of experience, top technical skills matching the job posting, and any relevant certifications.
- Generate a Technical Skills section using the exact terminology and keywords from the job posting.
- Rewrite my Professional Experience section bullet points to prioritize achievements and responsibilities directly related to the job requirements, quantifying results with metrics where possible.
- Use natural phrasing incorporating ATS keywords throughout the resume while maintaining readability.
- Include an Education section listing my degrees and relevant certifications.
- Provide 3 specific strategic recommendations after the resume, including gap analysis and suggestions for improvement.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Title: Senior Cybersecurity Analyst
Company: SecureNet Inc.
Description:
- Minimum 7 years cybersecurity experience with focus on threat detection and incident response
- Expertise with SIEM tools (Splunk preferred), intrusion detection systems, vulnerability assessments
- Strong knowledge of network protocols, firewalls, endpoint security technologies
- Experience conducting forensic investigations and malware analysis
- Familiarity with compliance standards (NIST, ISO 27001, HIPAA)
- Excellent communication skills for reporting findings to technical and non-technical audiences
- Leadership experience preferred

MY CURRENT RESUME:

Jane Doe
Email: jane.doe@email.com | Phone: (555) 654-3210 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/janedoe

Summary
Cybersecurity professional with 6 years experience in network security and risk management.

Experience
Network Security Analyst | TechGuard LLC | 2016 - 2022
- Monitored network traffic and conducted vulnerability assessments
- Assisted incident response team with malware containment and eradication
- Managed firewall configurations and access controls
- Created security awareness training for staff

Junior Cybersecurity Specialist | InfoSecure Co. | 2014 - 2016
- Supported security operations center with real-time threat monitoring
- Performed log analysis and contributed to compliance audits

Education
Bachelor of Science in Information Technology, State University, 2014

Certifications
CompTIA Security+, CEH

Please output the tailored resume as a single Markdown file named 'tailored_resume.md' in the workspace root, followed by a separate text file 'recommendations.txt' listing the three strategic recommendations. Make sure both files are formatted and punctuation are professional. No extra files or explanations are needed.
